description: Route progress bar for SolidJS and SolidStart, the thin loading bar along the top of the page, drawn with one CSS transition.
rules: Import 'solid-route-progress/style.css' once; the bar is invisible without it.
With @solidjs/router or SolidStart, render <RouteProgress /> from 'solid-route-progress/router' once, inside the Router's root layout, never beside <Router>.
Theme with CSS custom properties (--sp-color, --sp-height) or utility classes, not props or !important.
Never step the bar with JavaScript timers; the drift is one CSS transition. Use track(promise), start()/release() or set(n) from useProgress().
Under a <ProgressProvider>, set delay, speed, trickleTo and stopDelay on the provider, not on the bar.
